subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should the shared route-entry bundle investigation stop after the measured no-go, or should maintainers sponsor one specifically defined alternative hypothesis for the open performance audit?
rationale: The first experiment followed its stop condition and found no reduction; choosing another extraction target or an acceptable bundle target is product and performance-strategy judgment, not a mechanical follow-up.

options.title: Stop after the no-go
options.body: Keep the measured result as audit evidence and avoid further route-contract extraction until a broader performance plan identifies a higher-value target.

options.title: Sponsor a new measured target
options.body: Name one alternative import boundary and a material manifest-closure threshold before authorizing another bounded A/B experiment.

recommendation.title: Stop after the no-go
recommendation.body: Keep the measured result as audit evidence and avoid further route-contract extraction until a broader performance plan identifies a higher-value target.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the measurement methodology and have directly contributed the adjacent SSR route-performance work.
